SENSEX JUMPS 898 POINTS, NIFTY RECLAIMS 25,800

Indian stock markets rose for the second straight day on 20 November 2026. The BSE Sensex jumped 898 points to settle at 83,919.71, while the Nifty reclaimed the 25,800 mark.

For information only. Not investment advice.
